content.title: Kentucky State Police
content.text: Apply Today joinksp.comKentucky State Police Post Issues IAN Alert for Missing/Endangered Youth In Boone County FLORENCE, Ky. (March 13, 2026) – The Kentucky State Police has issued an IAN Alert for Jenny Dim, a 9-year-old female, last seen on MacIntosh Lane in Florence, Ky., on March 13 at approximately 5:00 p.m. Jenny is described as Asian, 4’4”, 53 pounds, with brown hair and eyes, wearing a mint-blue jacket, pink headphones, pierced ears, and no shoes. Anyone with information is urged to contact the Kentucky State Police Post at 859-428-1212 or call 911. Updates will be provided through social media and local media outlets. IAN Alerts are used when children under the age of 18 with autism or mental illness go missing and may be in danger. # # # Tags: Ian alertPost 6Return to News Archive HomeTIP LINE
